summary: The rally pushed to session highs into the final 40 minutes (S&P 500 about +2.6%, Nasdaq +3% at 3:13 PM ET on falling oil) while Nvidia stays down about 5% on the Huang board probe. Since the last update, AMD appears to have broken $505 (near $511 on an untimed quote) and Broadcom reached $320, so their levels were moved up; the other picks are unchanged and confidences trimmed for the little time left. Quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news reports.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Up about 13-14% on the Oppenheimer $600 upgrade after clearing $505; a break of $515 can push toward $522 into the close.

picks.name: Broadcom
picks.reason: Up about 9% off last week's 52-week low as AI chips rebound outside Nvidia; holding $320 and breaking $323 targets $328.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Up about 5% on JPMorgan's focus list (AWS growth near 40%) while the indexes make new session highs; $275 is the trigger.

picks.name: Meta Platforms
picks.reason: Up about 5% after JPMorgan added it to its focus list; a break of the 644.54 intraday high extends it into the close.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 5% on the board probe of CEO Huang while other chips rally; losing $173.50 reopens the 170.24 low.

picks.name: GE Vernova
picks.reason: Up about 7% on a German wind-turbine deal and the AI-power rebound; a push through $840 extends the trend day (no fresh quote found).
